name: The Kiprun Singapore 2026

ai_summary: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Kallang, Singapore. faqs.question: When is The Kiprun Singapore 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. The event will be held in Kallang, Singapore, at the Decathlon Singapore Lab venue, and is organized by MetaSport in partnership with Decathlon Singapore for participants of various running distances.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at the Decathlon Singapore Lab, located in Kallang, Singapore. This venue serves as the central hub for The Kiprun Singapore 2026, hosting all distance categories including the 21.1km half-marathon, 10km, 5km, and the 0.67km event for participants.
